gbm_population_evidence.quote: Primary CNS malignancy; Or a second primary tumor other than the confirmed solid tumor within the previous 3 years
Tumor types in the study will include: cervical, colorectal, endometrial, ovarian, esophageal, gastric adenocarcinoma, glioblastoma multiforme

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma multiforme is listed only in the brief summary (not a valid naming field per D27B) while primary CNS malignancy is an exclusion criterion; no GBM in conditions, title, inclusion or arm labels.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Subjects must have a histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced or metastatic solid tumor(s) for which no effective standard therapy is available or tolerable.

role_evidence.quote: evaluate the safety and tolerability of ESG401 as a single agent administered in 21-day treatment cycles

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational IV agent; exclusion criterion on hypersensitivity to irinotecan/camptothecin derivatives suggests a camptothecin-payload agent

coder_notes: Multi-tumour phase 1/2. Glioblastoma multiforme appears only in the brief summary tumour-type list; conditions, title, eligibility and arm labels do not name it, and primary CNS malignancy is excluded. Under D27B this is not an eligible GBM population (coded gbm_excluded; could alternatively be not_glioblastoma); basket coded false for the same reason. Flagged for adjudication.
